audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-3 were called Skill, and First item was given outright to Sylas.
audit.why: Mirror (sylas__ziggs) set rows 0-2 to Ziggs and row 5 to Skill with ratings rescaled, and the ranges back it: Bouncing Bomb is 850, Chain Lash 775, Abscond 400, Kingslayer 400. Before Sylas has the levels to chain E into a trade he simply cannot reach an 850-range poke champion.
audit.corrected: Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Sylas / Skill / Skill — matched full/content pairs with ratings, plus the four whys that argued the other way.
sources: kits: sylas Q 775, W 400, E 400; ziggs Q 850

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and whys[4] treat Level 6 as Sylas taking your ultimate away.
audit.why: Hijack copies the ultimate — Ziggs keeps Mega Inferno Bomb, Sylas gains a cast of it. It is 80/55/30s on 950 range, and that cooldown falling to 30 seconds at rank 3 is the real spike, not the theft. The mirror flagged this exact error as one a player dies to at 6.
audit.corrected: At 6 Hijack copies your bomb — he gains one, you keep yours — on 80 seconds at rank 1 over 950 units, so ult from outside that range.
sources: kits: sylas R text 'steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely', cd 80/55/30, range 950

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Abscond/Abduct a 'dash into chain-stun'. There is no stun in it. It also never states how short his engage actually is, and never times the anti-heal his sustain demands.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits' — a dash plus a pull, no CC, 400 range on 13/12/11/10/9. Kingslayer is also 400 range on 12/10.5/9/7.5/6 and heals him against champions, which is why Grievous Wounds timing decides every long trade.
audit.corrected: Abscond is 13s at rank 1 and only 400 range, and the recast pulls him to whatever the chain hits — no stun anywhere in it. Kingslayer heals off you at the same 400 range, so anti-heal before you try to win a long trade.
sources: kits: sylas E text/range 400/cd 13-9, W range 400 cd 12-6 heal flag

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named the engage but gave no number and repeated the stun error.
audit.why: 13s at rank 1 and 400 range is the concrete window — and knowing it is a pull rather than a stun changes whether you Satchel immediately or wait.
audit.corrected: Abscond 13s at rank 1, 400 range, no CC.

edits.before: Sylas trades into you at level 1 with Q and W Kingslayer sustain.
edits.after: Level 1 your 850 Q beats Chain Lash's 775 and he has no reach.

edits.before: At level 2 his gap-close and heal beat your fragile poke trades.
edits.after: At level 2 Abscond is 400 range — he cannot start on you yet.

edits.before: Level 3 E Abduct into Q gives him a burst all-in you can't answer.
edits.after: Level 3 your minefield punishes the 400-range gap he must cross.

edits.before: Level 6 R Hijack steals your Mega Inferno Bomb and turns it on you.
edits.after: At 6 Hijack copies your bomb — he gains one, you keep yours.

edits.before: First item spikes his burst-and-heal combo past your punish window.
edits.after: First item his burst-and-heal trades even against your own spike.

edits.before: His R Hijack steals YOUR Mega Inferno Bomb or another lane-relevant ult, turning your own power against you; never ult where he can immediately Hijack it into an all-in.
edits.after: Hijack COPIES your Mega Inferno Bomb — you keep yours, he gains one — on 80 seconds at rank 1 and 950 range, so ult from outside that and there is nothing for him to take.

edits.before: Steal your R with Hijack and all-in with it
edits.after: Copy your R with Hijack and all-in with it

edits.before: Late is worst: his R Hijack turns your own ult against you and his first-item combo out-bursts your poke. Play for peel, keep W Satchel for his E, and rely on team vision — you never win the straight fight.
edits.after: Late is worst: Hijack copies your ult rather than taking it, so he simply has one more, and his combo out-bursts your poke. Play for peel, keep Satchel for his E, and rely on team vision.

edits.before: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Abscond is 400 range and Kingslayer heals off you — buy anti-heal before any long trade.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Satchel has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond: 13 seconds at rank 1 and only 400 range, and the recast pulls him to whatever his chain hits — there is no stun in it. - Your W Satchel has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

notes: Two errors that get a player killed. First, the page said three times that Hijack steals your ultimate — it copies it, so you still have Mega Inferno Bomb and he also has one; the mirror caught the same thing from his side and I restated it here with the real 80/55/30 cooldown and 950 range. Second, Abscond/Abduct was called a 'dash into chain-stun'; Riot's text has no CC in it at all — it is a dash plus a chain pull. Chart realigned to the mirror: Ziggs owns levels 1-3 on raw range (850 Q against a 400-range engage), and First item is Skill rather than Sylas. Anti-heal timing for Kingslayer added, which _missing/sylas.json flags. Two page-level inconsistencies I did not touch, both noted by the mirror: diff reads HARD/8-10 here while some sibling matchups mix enum and prose ratings, and the kit's percentHealth flag on Satchel Charge contradicts Riot's description, so I wrote no resistances claim.
